purpose: Prospective CPU-only selection diagnostic agreed after four Claude review rounds; freeze all source and input hashes before new real-tile scores.
name: reconstruction-v3

advancement_candidate.name: rim1-original-source-chooser
advancement_candidate.checkpoint: fixed existing best.pt; no checkpoint re-selection

diagnostics.augmentation_transfer: Compare base and resolution donor maps on Split under identical common config, alongside original selected-pipeline scores.
diagnostics.augmentation_source: Own-city source maps support only original-control verification and the bounded source chooser; no target-side choices.
diagnostics.truth_marker_rule: One deterministic interior distance maximum per connected reference-raster component outside the original fixed OSM barrier; same parcel ID across components; ties use row-major order.
diagnostics.unreachable_references: Record absent raster IDs and references with no allowed marker pixels; keep every reference in vector scoring. A marker inside the barrier is an assertion failure.
diagnostics.no_merge_case: One common-config learned-marker/learned-surface counterpart with min_region_m2=0; diagnosis only.
diagnostics.marker_associations: Report each marker/free-interior component's positive-pixel overlap with zero, one or multiple raster reference IDs, including rejected components.
diagnostics.region_associations: Report overlaps covering at least 10% of each raster reference's area, including references associated with zero, one or multiple predicted regions and regions associated with multiple references.
required_outputs: clipped and interior matched counts and recall
diagnostics.interpretation: Truth substitutions are diagnostic probes, not deployable scores or mathematical upper bounds; point and region markers differ and interactions are reported. No-merge/truth cells cannot advance from this study.

statistics.pairing: Same sampled blocks across all arms and three fixed fitted seeds; preserve repeated-block multiplicity.
required_self_checks: same-arm paired deltas are exactly zero
duplicate block draws retain duplicate weight
statistics.limits: Conditional on the fitted seeds and repeatedly used selection geography; not selection-adjusted, not uncertainty across fitted seeds or new cities.

gates.failed_or_inconclusive: No automatic default replacement. Failure closes this rim recipe only. A one-city win remains a specialization.

prohibited_changes: new neural inference or training during this diagnostic
automatic promotion from diagnostic truth-assisted cells
next_training_decision: Margin-0 targets are the presumptive first three-seed arm; a documented marker/surface bottleneck may move one targeted marker or loss treatment ahead. A fresh arm must encode margin in targets, recipe, checkpoint and a separate verified cache namespace.
